mySaleOffersPage.heading: My Sale Offers
mySaleOffersPage.intro: View your currently active sale offers and offers that are reserved for a buyer. This overview is read-only.
mySaleOffersPage.currentCopy: Active offers and offers currently reserved for a buyer.
mySaleOffersPage.note: This page does not change any Units, fees or offers. A cancellation function has not been enabled yet.
mySaleOffersPage.empty: You currently have no sale offers that are active or reserved.
mySaleOffersPage.missingAccess: Your personal dashboard access is not available on this device yet. Please open this page from your BetInsight profile.
mySaleOffersPage.loadError: Your sale offers could not be loaded right now. Please try again.
mySaleOffersPage.legacyCurrentCopy: Active offers and offers currently reserved for a buyer.
mySaleOffersPage.legacyEmpty: You currently have no active or reserved sale offers of your own.
mySaleOffersPage.legacyImportantCopy: Only active offers can be edited or cancelled. Once a buyer has reserved an offer, changes are locked. For bank purchases, confirmation appears only after the buyer has reported the payment as sent. Confirm receipt only after the full amount has actually arrived in your bank account. Only then are the reserved Units transferred to the buyer.
mySaleOffersPage.legacyIntro: Here you can see your active sale offers and offers that have already been reserved for a buyer. Active offers can be adjusted in price or cancelled.
mySaleOffersPage.legacyLoading: Your sale offers are being loaded.
